name: Open-Meteo
description: A weather provider with no key: the weather at the device's location from Open-Meteo, for the Weather pages, the Weather Overlay and the Weather Visualizer. Free for non-commercial use; its data is CC BY 4.0, and the pages credit it.

properties.name: cacheHours
properties.title: Keep the Weather (hours)
properties.description: How long what Open-Meteo answered (the weather now and the forecast, one call) is kept and shared by every page, overlay and task. The free plan allows 10,000 calls a day. 0: ask every time.

properties.name: staleDays
properties.title: Forget Unused Answers After (days)
properties.description: A kept answer nobody has used for this many days (a place you moved away from) is removed. 0: never.
